body.name: Projected simultaneous leaf intervals
body.construction: \(\widehat I_G=[\inf_{g\in\widehat{\mathcal T}_{n,h_n}^{+},\,Q\in\widehat{\mathcal P}_{X,n}:Q(G)\ge p_{\min,n}/2}\ell_G(g;Q),\sup_{g\in\widehat{\mathcal T}_{n,h_n}^{+},\,Q\in\widehat{\mathcal P}_{X,n}:Q(G)\ge p_{\min,n}/2}\ell_G(g;Q)]\) for every \(G\in\mathcal G_n\).
